title: Words and costs in project analytics
summary: Projects show words, proofreading and costs, routine emails arrive as one summary, and Playground gets Word and PowerPoint pages.

sections.title: Words and costs in project analytics
sections.note: See what a project translates, who proofreads it and what it costs.

items.body: Analytics shows words delivered and proofread, by language and linguist
See a project's cost so far and the work still owed
Count words per file with **Word counts** in Files
Track proofreading across every project from the Portfolio

sections.title: Email summaries
sections.note: Routine notification emails now arrive together.

items.body: Routine emails come as one hourly summary by default
Choose immediately, every 30 or 60 minutes, or off
Admins set the default for the organization
Approvals and mentions are still emailed straight away

sections.title: Office and PDF documents in Playground
sections.note: Word and PowerPoint get their own pages, and scanned PDFs read better.

items.body: Translate Word and PowerPoint files from their own pages
Edits made in Word, PowerPoint or Excel update the segments
Scanned and photographed PDFs, even tilted ones, are read more accurately
Segment editors: keyboard shortcuts to move, save and set status
Quality: QE, AI LQA and Human LQA reports open in one dialog
Translation Memory: options DeepL and Azure ignore are locked
Brand kit: upload a whole font family as a ZIP or several files
Image Creator: images keep their size after a chat edit
Translated PDFs keep pictures that were not translated
Playground: Retry and Restart charge the price they showed
Image Translator: review rows show their own text
Translate Video: transliteration suggestions no longer add double spaces
